User.title: User
User.description: Represents a user of the LocalKey application.

id.description: Unique identifier for the user entity.

role.description: User's role (e.g., user, partner, admin). This is for client-side logic and not used in security rules.

Partner.title: Partner
Partner.description: Represents a partner location offering deals, awaiting approval.

id.description: Unique identifier for the partner entity, matching the user ID.

companyName.description: The legal name of the company.

regCom.description: Numărul de înregistrare la Registrul Comerțului.

address.description: The full address of the company headquarters.

city.description: The city of the company headquarters.

county.description: The county of the company headquarters.

contactName.description: Name of the primary contact person.

status.description: The approval status of the partner.

Offer.title: Offer
Offer.description: Represents an offer available to users.

id.description: Unique identifier for the offer entity.

validFrom.description: Date and time when the offer becomes valid.

validUntil.description: Date and time when the offer expires.

Redemption.title: Redemption
Redemption.description: Represents a user redeeming an offer at a partner location.

id.description: Unique identifier for the redemption record.

redemptionTime.description: Date and time when the offer was redeemed.

InviteCode.title: InviteCode
InviteCode.description: Represents an invitation code for new users.

id.description: Unique identifier for the invite code document.

status.description: The status of the invite code.

generatedBy.description: ID of the user who generated the code.

redeemedByUserId.description: ID of the user who redeemed the code.

redeemedAt.description: Timestamp when the code was redeemed.

definition.description: Stores user profiles. Each document is keyed by the user's unique Firebase Auth ID.

params.name: userId
params.description: The unique Firebase Auth ID of the user.

definition.description: Stores partner profiles, including applications. Each document is keyed by a unique user ID which will be assigned the partner role upon approval.

params.name: partnerId
params.description: The unique user ID for the partner.

definition.description: Stores offer details. Includes the partnerId for retrieving offers by partner.

params.name: offerId
params.description: The unique identifier for the offer.

definition.description: Stores all invitation codes. Allows for efficient querying to validate codes upon user registration.

params.name: inviteCodeId
params.description: The unique identifier for the invite code document.

definition.description: Stores redemption records for each user. Includes userId, offerId, and partnerId for authorization independence.

params.name: userId
params.description: The unique Firebase Auth ID of the user.

params.name: redemptionId
params.description: The unique identifier for the redemption record.

definition.description: Marks a user as an administrator. The existence of a document with the user's ID in this collection grants admin privileges.

params.name: userId
params.description: The unique Firebase Auth ID of the administrator.

definition.description: Marks a user as a partner. The existence of a document with the user's ID in this collection grants partner privileges.

params.name: userId
params.description: The unique Firebase Auth ID of the partner.

firestore.reasoning: This Firestore structure is designed to support the LocalKey application's core features, including user authentication, a separate partner application flow with manual approval, QR code generation for offer redemptions, usage tracking, and a mandatory invitation system for regular users, while prioritizing security and scalability. A top-level `partners` collection is used for applications, allowing admins to easily list and review them. A top-level `invite_codes` collection is used to allow for efficient global queries to validate invite codes during user registration.
